title: Honor's humanoid robot "Lightning" ran 100 meters in 9.32 seconds during a test ahead of the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, beating Usain Bolt's human record of 9.58 seconds.
text:
Honor's humanoid robot "Lightning" ran 100 meters in 9.32 seconds during a test ahead of the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, beating Usain Bolt's human record of 9.58 seconds."

"The robot reached a peak speed of 14.5 m/s.
